title: Are carbohydrates bad for health?
subtitle: Evidence-based answer to the common question: are carbohydrates bad for health?
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports benefits of high-fiber carbohydrates and risks of excessive added sugars. Emerging evidence examines long-term impact of low-carb diets. Some evidence is moderate due to study limitations.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
